caption: A fun & easy treat for babies / toddlers. I made the viral YoBaby Yogurt Pops, and here are simple steps:  (1) Cut or flatten fruits into appropriate forms (to avoid choking), and only include mix-ins that are appropriate for your child’s diet and developmental stage  (2) Add fruits to YoBaby Whole Milk Yogurt cups and mix  (3) Add a popsicle stick  (4) Freeze & serve! I used silicone popsicle sticks with built-in drip trays that are easier for my one year old toddler to hold & are less messy.  @stonyfield YoBaby Organic Yogurt is one of Zen’s favorite breakfast and/or snack options — made with high quality ingredients, and no harmful pesticides, so parents can feel good feeding it to baby! I also like the fact that YoBaby Organic Yogurt made with Real Fruit (Not applicable for Vanilla and Plain Flavors). I’m excited to add this easy popsicle treat as another go-to afternoon snack menu.  #StonyfieldYoBaby #Sponsored #GoodOnPurpose #Organic #Stonyfield #BLW #BabyLedWeaning #EasySnackideas #toddlersnacks #babysnacks #babyfood #babyrecipes #blwrecipes #weaningideas
